# AstryxDateRangeInput { #anylumino.AstryxDateRangeInput }

```python
AstryxDateRangeInput(value=None, *, label='', **props)
```

Render an Astryx date-range input.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name    | Type                        | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Default   |
|---------|-----------------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------|
| value   | Mapping\[str, str\] \| None | Synchronized component value.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | `None`    |
| label   | str                         | Visible or accessible label for the component.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `''`      |
| **props | Any                         | JSON-safe DateRangeInput props. Useful keys: isLabelHidden, description, isOptional, isRequired, isDisabled, isLoading, min, max, presets, hasClear, placeholder, size, status, labelTooltip, numberOfMonths, className, and style. anylumino manages label, value, and change synchronization. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/DateRangeInput>. | `{}`      |
